subject: Private/VPC architecture review — next steps & scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-analytics.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private/VPC architecture review — next steps & scheduling

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier — appreciate you walking us through Acme's ingest volumes and the regulatory constraints around stored telemetry. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- What we heard: Acme needs a private deployment (VPC) with strict network egress controls, BYOK for keys, and audit logs retained for 12 months. Expected steady-state inference throughput ~3000 tokens/sec with spikes to 10k during nightly batch jobs.
- Next step: schedule a technical architecture review (Private/VPC deep-dive) with your infra and security teams + our private deployment engineers. We'll cover VPC peering/VPN options, CIDR/networking, KMS integration, and deployment footprint.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu Jun 11, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu Jun 11, 3:00–4:00 PM PT
- Fri Jun 12, 9:00–10:00 AM PT

Please let me know which slot works best or suggest two options and we'll send calendar invites. If helpful, I'm attaching a lightweight architecture diagram and our private deployment checklist to speed the review. Also, if you can share your preferred VPC CIDR ranges and whether you want KMS via AWS KMS or customer HSM, that will help us prepare.

Attachments: architecture-diagram.pdf, redwood-private-deploy-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — look forward to continuing this.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private/VPC architecture review — next steps & scheduling

Thanks Marissa — good summary. Thu 3:00–4:00 PM PT works for our infra folks (I'll loop them in). Quick answers up front:
- CIDR: 10.10.0.0/16 (we can expand to /15 if needed)
- KMS: prefer customer-managed AWS KMS for keys; HSM is a potential future ask but not required for the POC
- Audit requirements: 12 months with S3 lifecycle rules; SOC2 evidence will be requested by procurement later

I'll invite our infrastructure lead (Priya) and our security engineer (Samir Kumar) on the confirmed invite. Please include any Zoom link and the agenda.

Alex
Alex Jenkins
Sr. Cloud Architect, Acme Analytics
alex.jenkins@acme-analytics.com | +1 (617) 555-0890

Subject: Re: Private/VPC architecture review — next steps & scheduling

Perfect — thanks Alex. I've scheduled Thu Jun 11, 3:00–4:00 PM PT and sent a calendar invite (Zoom link included). Agenda:

1) 3:00–3:10 PM — Introductions & goals for the session
2) 3:10–3:25 PM — Acme current infra & constraints (Alex / Priya / Samir)
3) 3:25–3:45 PM — Redwood Private deployment options (VPC peering vs. Private Connect, KMS/HSM patterns, sizing)
4) 3:45–4:00 PM — Action items & next steps (network prep, POC timeline)

Dev Patel (cc'd) will lead the technical walkthrough from our side and is the primary engineer for Private deployments. Rishi is looped for commercial/commit alignment.

I've reattached the architecture diagram and checklist to the calendar event. If there's anything specific you want on the agenda, flag it here and we'll adjust before EOD.

See you Thursday — I'll follow up with a short pre-read for Dev and Samir.

— Marissa

Thanks Marissa — invite received and added to our calendar. Priya / Samir / I will review the pre-read; Samir will have our audit/logging retention matrix ready. One ask before the call: can you share the expected egress IP ranges Redwood will use for the Private deployment (so our firewall team can pre-configure rules)?

If you can send those today, we'll be able to validate network constraints before the meeting.

Best,
Alex
